pages.title: Fays
text: Where the light is strange, fays dance in the air. They are small and gentle, and flee from monsters.

Brush one for its reagent once a minute, and tempt and breed it with **sugar** or a **honey bottle**. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though it has no gift of its own.

pages.title: Three kinds
text: - **Glimmer Fay**: gold, over the Glimmer Ridge. Drops **Fay Dust**.
- **Prism Fay**: rose, over the Crystal Fields. Drops **Fay Petals** (pink dye).
- **Marsh Fay**: green, over the Reed Fen. A few fly with the [Colossus Warden](colossus_warden). Drops **Fay Sparks**.
A fay has **8 health** and no armour, flies in ones to threes, and drops **1 to 3** of its reagent, more with Looting.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
- **Glimmer Fay**: up to 2 Glowstone Dust. Breed with **sugar or a honey bottle**.
- **Prism Fay**: up to 2 Pink Petals and up to 1 Amethyst Shard. Breed with **sugar or a honey bottle**.
- **Marsh Fay**: up to 1 Glow Berries and up to 1 Glowstone Dust. Breed with **sugar or a honey bottle**.
